title: “Fighting Amalek in Our Time” SCA Shabbat Message by Carol Tawil

chapters.title: Introduction to Parshat Shelah and Amalek
chapters.about: Introduction to the parasha, the story of Amalek, and the daily relevance of the mitzvah.

chapters.title: Rashi's Mashal on Water and Doubt
chapters.about: The complaint about water in Sefer Shemot and Rashi's mashal about the child on his father's shoulders.

chapters.title: Parshat Ki Tesse and Business Dishonesty
chapters.about: Rashi's hekesh in Parshat Ki Tesse regarding honesty in business and the Malbim's perspective on Amalek.

chapters.title: Conquering the Yetzer Hara
chapters.about: The sar of Amalek, its connection to the yetzer hara, and how to eradicate Amalek through emunah and midot.

summary: Carol Tallo explores how the mitzvah to eradicate Amalek is relevant on a daily basis by examining the stories preceding Amalek in Parashat Shelah and Sefer Debarim. She discusses Rashi's explanations regarding doubt in Hashem and dishonesty in business, the Malbim's view on Amalek's ideology, and how conquering Amalek relates to the yetzer hara and improving midot.
questions: How is the mitzvah of Amalek relevant on a daily basis nowadays?
Why does the story of Amalek follow the complaint about water in Sefer Shemot?
What does Rashi explain about the connection between business dishonesty and Amalek?
How does the Malbim differentiate Amalek from other armies?
In what way is the sar of Amalek connected to the yetzer hara?
